result.notes: All coverage fields are null because the only source, DX06 (a Morgan Lewis law-firm alert), says nothing about which buildings, units or owners Seattle Mun. Code ch. 7.34 covers. It gives no unit thresholds, construction-date cutoffs, owner-occupancy exemptions or landlord-size conditions. The previous summary was removed for two reasons. First, the claim that the source 'states no building, unit-count or landlord-size limits' is an inference from silence, and no verbatim passage supports it. Second, the reference to 'Seattle multifamily properties' describes the properties at issue in the Nicolas v. Essex and Romano v. UDR lawsuits, not the ordinance's coverage scope. The alert's description of the ordinance ('expressly prohibits specified algorithmic coordinating services') describes landlord conduct, not coverage, so it cannot support a coverage summary. Coverage should be filled in from the official text of Seattle Mun. Code ch. 7.34 once it is captured.
